about: Frozen judge rows (endstage-report.md 1d, tier 1): each row is a false clean Chrome measured; a judge or table change that answers otherwise fails judge-frozen.test.mjs. Changing a row or a table needs a `changes` row { id, was, now, adr, why, program } naming an ADR in docs/decisions.md and a program whose Chrome result shows the new answer right.
